description: This file contains definitions for internal grain classes related to stream lifecycle management within an Orleans-based distributed system, including producer and consumer grains with methods for testing stream cleanup, deactivation, and extension binding.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain responsible for managing stream lifecycle as a producer, including testing removal and deactivation functionalities.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain responsible for managing stream lifecycle as a consumer, including methods for transitioning to consumer state.

methods.name: TestInternalRemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes the producer role from the stream and persists the state.

methods.name: DoBadDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Deactivates the grain without proper stream closing, used for testing deactivation behavior.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Initializes the grain as a stream consumer and sets up observation and pub/sub registration for testing.
